steps.text: How many men have fallen before you?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: (Speaking Ursine).

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Of course. I will bring it back for you.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: ...... (Speaking Ursine)......?

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: No. I'm not going to Chernobog.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Rest.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: You'll be safe here.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Get some rest.
How many men have fallen before me?
Drop your weapon!

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Just you...?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Move and I shoot!

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Shoot first. Then ask questions.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: What? He... disappeared?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: No... I saw your file. You're Faust, one of their leaders. Your Arts won't fool me!

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: I know this is just an optical trick. If I shoot, you'll still have a bolt in your head.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Wrong.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Can you predict my movements?

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: The two of us, lone crossbowmen. If we both pull the trigger at the same time, we both die.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: What's your name?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Codename GreyThroat. When did you get behind me?

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: The third time you blinked.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: You're pretty direct...

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: You've been separated from your squad. I'm not here to kill people who don't want a fight.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: We're enemies.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Rhodes Island is here to save the Infected. I saw you helping them.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Those were my comrades. You're my enemy.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: When did Rhodes Island hire someone so naive?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Yes, I'm naive. All I can do is follow orders. I freeze up whenever I have to make a decision for myself.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: You need to be careful.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Watch your finger!

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: That's a single shot crossbow. If I dodge your bolt, you're dead. Don't pull that trigger.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: If you only follow orders, if you rely on everyone else to tell you what to do, that can only end poorly.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Most of the sheep who blindly take orders aren't actually dependent on anyone. They just haven't started thinking for themselves...

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: And those who have no direction in life, they're just empty machines looking for a sense of accomplishment, and meaning.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: You activate, and perform your function, you input a goal, you achieve your goal, until you consume everything around you, and you consume those you serve.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: I won't.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: You're inexperienced.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: I saw your interaction with the Infected back there. You're doing the right thing.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Your opinion means nothing to me.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Faust, you've been avoiding the L. G. D. Even the ones who are out here on their own, you haven't shot at them. I've been watching you.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Don't take my patience for weakness. If I ambushed you, you'd be dead.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: But you didn't.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: You're exhausted. Take it from a crossbowman, your string is drawn too tight. It's definitely going to snap.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Take it from a crossbowman, you're too much.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: You've also seen those... special Infected. We can figure this one out together.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Maybe you're right.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Wait!

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: But there's nothing I can do.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: (He disappeared the instant he moved...? I can't figure his position!)

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Why haven't you killed me?

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: You didn't shoot. Neither will I.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: But next time? If you don't kill me, I will kill you.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: I don't want to hurt you!

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: That's too bad.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: I guess you need someone to answer you. Without an answer, you can't understand.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Don't worry about it. Killing, dying, these are everyday facts of life. Even for Rhodes Island.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Why can't we work together to save them?

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: I really wish I could. But I know I can't.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: Don't follow me.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: You still don't know them. You don't yet have the whole picture.

steps.name: Faust
steps.text: ...and me? There's nothing I can do anymore.
How many men have fallen because of things I did? How many men have fallen because of things I didn't do?
